segments.title: 第176章 愛情的味道
segments.content:
Rekindling the Verdant Years Chapter 176 The Scent of Love

When Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng arrived at the backstage prep area, they immediately saw Kong Junxiang, his face fraught with anxiety.

It was only then that Li Luo realized Kong Junxiang had disappeared not long after accompanying them to their seats in the open space before the stage.

At first, Li Luo thought he had gone to the restroom. After all, Teacher Ding had also moved a chair over, and there was no way Kong Junxiang would let Teacher Ding sit there and watch the show alone.

But he hadn't expected to see Kong Junxiang here.

Walking over to Kong Junxiang with a curious expression, Li Luo asked, "Teacher Kong, what are you doing here?"

Suddenly being greeted, the anxious Kong Junxiang jumped, clearly a bit startled.

When he turned to see Li Luo, Kong Junxiang let out a small sigh of relief.

"Oh, it's you," Kong Junxiang said, having recovered. "You and Yan Zhusheng have a performance with the Rock Club tonight, right?"

"That's right," Li Luo nodded, then asked again, "So, Teacher Kong, you're here to...?"

"Ahem, ahem..." Kong Junxiang cleared his throat, looking a little embarrassed. He didn't answer directly, asking instead, "Teacher Ding didn't say anything after I left just now, did she?"

"No, she's watching the show," Li Luo said.

"That's good." Kong Junxiang took a deep breath, then slowly exhaled and finally explained to Li Luo, "After this performance on stage ends, the next one is mine."

Hearing this, Li Luo immediately raised his eyebrows.

Beside him, Yan Zhusheng also looked curious. "What is Teacher Kong performing?"

"I'm not as talented as you all," Kong Junxiang said with a couple of awkward laughs. "I'm just going up to sing a song."

"Oh," Yan Zhusheng nodded. "You're singing it for Teacher Ding."

Li Luo coughed twice and advised Yan Zhusheng, "Some things shouldn't be said so directly. We need to be a little more subtle, otherwise it's so embarrassing for Teacher Kong."

"Then how should I say it?" Yan Zhusheng tilted her head and asked.

"You should say," Li Luo thought for a moment, "Teacher Kong, you're probably planning to sing this song for the person you like, right?"

Kong Junxiang was utterly exasperated. "...If you two don't know how to talk, you can just not talk."

"See?" Yan Zhusheng turned her head to look at Li Luo. "Isn't that the same as what I said?"

"It's the same meaning, but my words are more subtle," Li Luo said shamelessly. "Good luck, Teacher Kong! We'll be in the back cheering you on!"

"Don't say any more. The more you talk, the more nervous I get," Kong Junxiang rubbed his hands, breathing out a puff of white mist in the cold wind. "During the rehearsal, I had a hard time finding the right cue to start singing. I was always half a beat slow."

"What are you singing?" Li Luo thought for a moment. "If you're half a beat slow, I can give you a reminder later."

After discussing the details with Kong Junxiang, Li Luo secretly pulled Yan Zhusheng into a corner backstage and gave her some instructions.

Yan Zhusheng nodded and immediately left the backstage area, her destination unknown.

The bonfire party began around seven in the evening. After several exciting performances, the female host, a senior from Year Two, took the stage again to announce:

"Thank you to the seniors from Year Three, Class Thirteen for their wonderful performance. It not only showcased everyone's fighting spirit for the Gaokao but also unearthed the small joys of daily campus life."

"And following our fellow students' wonderful performances, a teacher has volunteered to bring us a song that perfectly fits the theme of our bonfire party."

"Next, let's welcome the homeroom teacher of Year One, Class Eight, Teacher Kong Junxiang, who will perform for us 'A Fire in Winter'!"

"Pfft..." Zhang Guohuang, who was sitting up straight and staring at the stage entrance through a pair of binoculars, nearly burst out laughing the moment he saw Kong Junxiang appear in his view, coupled with the words "A Fire in Winter" in his ears.

"What kind of taste does Old Kong have? Such a corny song..."

"Corny or not, it's a classic," Zhu Yufei said with a chuckle. "And it really does fit the bonfire party theme."

Sitting next to Teacher Ding, Xu Yinghuan was first surprised when she heard the host's announcement, then immediately turned her head to look at Teacher Ding.

She saw that Ding Xiang was also wearing a look of astonishment.

When she saw Kong Junxiang's figure actually appear on stage, holding a microphone with a nervous look on his face, Ding Xiang covered her mouth, a touch of emotion in her eyes.

Then, an irrepressible smile appeared on her face.

Seeing this, Class Eight's number one shipper was overcome with sweetness. A blissful smile spread across her face, the corners of her mouth rising uncontrollably as she cheered for Teacher Kong wildly in her heart.

She never expected this, she really never did.

It was one thing to usually get her fix from Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng's home-cooked fare, but Xu Yinghuan had never anticipated that she would now get to regularly enjoy a grand feast personally prepared by her own homeroom teacher.

"Teacher Ding, it's Teacher Kong," Xu Yinghuan leaned into Ding Xiang's ear, suppressing her excitement and testing the waters, "Didn't he say he was going to the restroom just now?"

"I didn't expect it either." Ding Xiang's emotions were clearly in turmoil as well, but in front of her student, she maintained her composure as a teacher.

"This song... Teacher Kong must be singing it for you, right, Teacher Ding?" Xu Yinghuan continued, trying hard to mine for more sweetness.

The corners of Ding Xiang's mouth curled up slightly, but she still shook her head with a smile. "You can't say that. He's your homeroom teacher, so of course this song is also for all of you."

Although she didn't get Teacher Ding's direct admission, this considerate way of putting Teacher Kong first was enough to make Xu Yinghuan burst with delight.

Yes, yes, that was perfectly said! Xu Yinghuan chatted happily with Teacher Ding.

Soon, the music began to play from the stage.

Kong Junxiang stood nervously on stage, listening carefully to the rhythm.

He had originally planned to find Ding Xiang's location the moment he got on stage, then sing the song while looking her in the eyes.

But he had clearly miscalculated.

He certainly could have found her if he looked carefully.

But he was just too nervous after getting on stage. Kong Junxiang's gaze swept across the crowd, only to be quickly interrupted by the music.

He then panicked, quickly retracting his gaze and trying his best to discern the melody of the intro.

If things had gone according to the original plan, he likely would have started the main verse half a beat late.

But this time was different.

Just as the music was about to reach the main verse, three "da, da, da" drum beats suddenly came from backstage.

The drum beats were almost inaudible to the audience.

But to Kong Junxiang, who had been waiting with full concentration, they were like three claps of thunder, instantly pulling him into the rhythm of the main verse.

"You are like a fire in winter"

"Its blazing flames have warmed the bottom of my heart"

Once he entered the main verse smoothly, Kong Junxiang instantly got into the zone, singing with fluency and naturalness.

Though he was still trembling a little from nervousness, at a bonfire party, naturally no one would mind.

Ding Xiang sat at the very front of Class Eight, listening intently to the song Kong Junxiang was singing. A smile unknowingly appeared on her face, growing wider and happier, something she herself didn't even realize.

Only Xu Yinghuan, who had been feasting on the sweet moments, secretly saw this scene. She was instantly so happy she could stomp her feet, her face filled with satisfaction.

And when Kong Junxiang sang "Your big eyes, bright and sparkling, like the brightest star in the sky," two faint blushes clearly appeared on Ding Xiang's cheeks.

The Class Eight students sitting behind them also let out knowing laughs and jeers.

Zhang Guohuang even stood up and shouted at the stage, "Teacher Kong, you're awesome! You're singing great!"

On stage, Kong Junxiang had been singing just fine, but he was nearly thrown off by that kid Zhang Guohuang's shout.

But thanks to Zhang Guohuang's shout, Kong Junxiang followed the sound and found his position at a glance.

Then, using Zhang Guohuang's position as a reference point, he looked forward and immediately found Ding Xiang.

The next second, their eyes met across the distance. Ding Xiang lowered her head a bit shyly and tucked a stray strand of hair behind her ear.

But she quickly raised her head again, looked at Kong Junxiang on stage, and even waved at him.

And so, Kong Junxiang on stage waved back at the same time.

Everyone else thought this Teacher Kong was waving at the students of his class.

But only the students of Class Eight knew exactly who their homeroom teacher was waving to.

Xu Yinghuan, who took all of this in, swayed happily from side to side.

Just then, Yan Zhusheng's figure suddenly appeared in front of Class Eight and walked up to Ding Xiang.

"Zhusheng?" Xu Yinghuan stared at Yan Zhusheng, who had popped up out of nowhere, and was stunned for a moment. "Why are you back? Didn't you say you were going backstage to prepare?"

"Li Luo sent me," Yan Zhusheng said, suddenly pulling a bunch of flowers from behind her back and handing them to Ding Xiang. "Teacher Ding, for you. Li Luo said you can decide for yourself whether to go up or not."

Ding Xiang took the bouquet in a daze and gave it a simple look.

She saw there were four or five flowers. They had a faint fragrance, and were clearly real.

The stems were wrapped only with a few paper towels, and she could even vaguely smell the faint fragrance of soil.

"Yan Zhusheng, this... where did you get this from?" Ding Xiang couldn't help but ask.

Yan Zhusheng blinked, recalling something in her mind. "It was the scent of love that guided them into Teacher Ding's hands."

Ding Xiang was speechless. "..."

"Teacher Ding, you should hurry up there," Xu Yinghuan reminded her in a whisper from the side. "Teacher Kong is about to finish the song."

With Xu Yinghuan's reminder, Ding Xiang temporarily stopped thinking about questions like where these flowers came from.

She looked at Kong Junxiang on stage again and bit her lip. She hadn't even stood up yet, but the thoughts and fantasies in her mind had already made her cheeks blush and her earlobes burn.

But in the end, she stood up. Under Xu Yinghuan's expectant gaze, she moved through the rows of chairs and walked resolutely toward the stage.

(End of Chapter)
